answer: An operator running 169 keys as a result forfeits for 169 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the terrace quota and the yarrow admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 2 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. Since the throttle counters live in the vertex ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. That is 33 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
